verdict.rationale: Honeycomb exposes a REST API, with a downloadable OpenAPI spec, for programmatically managing datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs, environments and API keys. It also offers an MCP server and a CRUD marker CLI (honeymarker), so many items can be scripted, but only as a do-it-yourself workaround. Nothing in the evidence shows native bulk or batch operations that act on many items at once. missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API endpoints or UI multi-select actions, bulk edit/delete of triggers/SLOs/boards, agent-driven bulk operations via MCP, independent corroboration.
